g.text: Recent evolution of the Pacific Decadal Oscillation index

text.style: font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #657587

g.text: Positive and negative values describe the sign of the PDO index, not SST anomalies at individual locations.

text.style: font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #657587

g.text: The 12-month running mean is descriptive smoothing; it does not define an official PDO phase transition.

g.text: Data: NOAA NCEI | PDO derived from ERSSTv6
